an3.65:1.2: Ekaṃ samayaṃ Bhagavā Kosalesu cārikaṃ caramāno mahatā bhikkhusaṅghena saddhiṃ yena Kesaputtaṃ nāma Kālāmānaṃ nigamo tad avasari.
an3.65:1.4: samaṇo khalu bho Gotamo Sakyaputto Sakyakulā pabbajito Kesaputtaṃ anupatto.
an3.65:1.5: Taṃ kho pana Bhagavantaṃ Gotamaṃ evaṃ kalyāṇo kittisaddo abbhuggato --
an3.65:1.6: iti pi so Bhagavā arahaṃ sammāsambuddho vijjācaraṇasampanno . . . pe . . . pakāseti.
an3.65:1.7: Sādhu kho pana tathārūpānaṃ arahataṃ dassanaṃ hotī ti.
an3.65:2.1: Atha kho Kesaputtiyā Kālāmā yena Bhagavā ten' upasaṅkamiṃsu. Upasaṅkamitvā appekacce Bhagavantaṃ abhivadetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdiṃsu, appekacce Bhagavatā saddhiṃ sammodiṃsu sammodanīyaṃ kathaṃ sārāṇīyaṃ vītisāretvā ekamantaṃ nisīdiṃsu, appekacce yena Bhagavā ten' añjaliṃ paṇāmetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdiṃsu, appekacce nāmagottaṃ sāvetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdiṃsu, appekacce tuṇhībhūtā ekamantaṃ nisīdiṃsu. Ekamantaṃ nisinnā kho Kesaputtiyā Kālāmā Bhagavantaṃ etad avocuṃ:-.
an3.65:3.1: Santi bhante eke samaṇabrāhmaṇā Kesaputtaṃ āgacchanti.
an3.65:3.2: Te sakaṃ yeva vādaṃ dīpenti jotenti, paravādaṃ pana khuṃsenti vambhenti paribhavanti opapakkhiṃ karonti.
an3.65:3.3: Apare pi bhante eke samaṇabrāhmaṇā Kesaputtaṃ āgacchanti.
an3.65:3.4: Te pi sakaṃ yeva vādaṃ dīpenti jotenti paravādaṃ pana khuṃsenti vambhenti paribhavanti opapakkhiṃ karonti.
an3.65:3.5: Tesaṃ no bhante amhākam hot' eva kaṅkhā hoti vicikicchā --
an3.65:3.6: ko si nāma imesaṃ bhavantānaṃ samaṇānaṃ saccaṃ āha ko musā ti? 3. Alaṃ
an3.65:3.7: hi vo Kālāmā kaṅkhituṃ alaṃ vicikicchituṃ.
an3.65:3.8: Kaṅkhāniye va pana vo ṭhāne vicikicchā uppannā.
an3.65:4.1: Etha tumhe Kālāmā mā anussavena mā paramparāya mā itikirāya mā piṭakasampadānena mā takkahetu mā nayahetu mā ākāraparivitakkena mā diṭṭhinijjhānakkhantiyā mā bhavyarūpatāya mā samaṇo no garū ti,
an3.65:4.2: yadā tumhe Kālāmā attanā va jāneyyātha --
an3.65:4.3: ime dhammā akusalā ime dhammā sāvajjā ime dhammā viññugarahitā ime dhammā samattā samādinnā ahitāya dukkhāya saṃvattantī ti -- atha tumhe Kālāmā pajaheyyātha. 4.
an3.65:5.2: lobho purisassa ajjhattaṃ uppajjamāno uppajjati hitāya vā ahitāya vā ti?
an3.65:7.1: Luddho panāyaṃ Kālāmā purisapuggalo lobhena abhibhūto pariyādinnacitto pāṇaṃ pi hanti adinnam pi ādiyati paradāram pi gacchati musā pi bhaṇati param pi tathattāya samādapeti yaṃ 'sa hoti dīgharattaṃ ahitāya dukkhāyā ti.
an3.65:9.2: doso purisassa ajjhattaṃ uppajjamāno uppajjati hitāya vā ahitāya vā ti?
an3.65:11.1: Duṭṭho panāyaṃ Kālāmā purisapuggalo dosena abhibhūto pariyādinnacitto pāṇam pi hanti adinnam pi ādiyati paradāram pi gacchati musā pi bhaṇati param pi tathattāya samādapeti yaṃ 'sa hoti dīgharattaṃ ahitāya dukkhāyā ti.
an3.65:13.2: moho purisassa ajjhattaṃ uppajjamāno uppajjati hitāya vā ahitāya vā ti.
an3.65:15.1: Mūḷho panāyaṃ Kālāmā purisapuggalo mohena abhibhūto pariyādinnacitto pāṇam pi hanti adinnam pi ādiyati paradāram pi gacchati musā pi bhaṇati param pi tathattāya samādapeti yaṃ 'sa hoti dīgharattaṃ ahitāya dukkhāyā ti.
an3.65:17.1: Taṃ kiṃ maññatha Kālāmā -- ime dhammā kusalā vā akusalā vā ti?
an3.65:23.1: Samattā samādinnā ahitāya dukkhāya saṃvattanti no vā
an3.65:24.1: Samattā bhante samādinnā ahitāya dukkhāya saṃvattanti
an3.65:25.1: Iti kho Kālāmā yaṃ tam avocumha --
an3.65:25.3: mā anussavena mā paramparāya mā itikirāya mā piṭakasampadānena mā takkahetu mā nayahetu mā ākāraparivitakkena mā diṭṭhinijjhānakkhantiyā mā bhavyarūpatāya mā samaṇo no garū ti,
an3.65:25.4: yadā tumhe Kālāmā attanā va jāneyyātha --
an3.65:25.5: ime dhammā akusalā ime dhammā sāvajjā ime dhammā viññugarahitā ime dhammā samattā samādinnā ahitāya dukkhāya saṃvattantī ti -- atha tumhe Kālāmā pajaheyyāthā ti --
an3.65:25.6: iti yaṃ taṃ vuttaṃ idam etaṃ paṭicca vuttaṃ. 9.
an3.65:26.1: Etha tumhe Kālāmā mā anussavena mā parampāraya . . . pe . . . garū ti,
an3.65:26.2: yadā tumhe Kālāmā attanā va jāneyyātha --
an3.65:26.3: ime dhammā kusalā ime dhammā anavajjā ime dhammā viññuppasatthā ime dhammā samattā samādinnā hitāya sukhāya saṃvattantī ti -- atha tumhe Kālāmā upasampajja vihareyyātha. 10.
an3.65:27.2: alobho purisassa ajjhattaṃ uppajjamāno uppajjati hitāya vā ahitāya vā ti?
an3.65:29.1: Aluddho panāyaṃ Kālāmā purisapuggalo lobhena anabhibhūto apariyādinnacitto n' eva pāṇaṃ hanti na adinnam ādiyati na paradāraṃ gacchati na musā bhaṇati paraṃ pi tathattāya samādapeti yaṃ 'sa hoti dīgharattaṃ hitāya sukhāyā ti?
an3.65:31.2: adoso purisassa ajjhattaṃ uppajjamāno uppajjati hitāya vā ti ahitāya vā ti? Hitāya bhante. Aduṭṭho panāyaṃ Kālāmā purisapuggalo dosena anabhibhūto apariyādinnacitto n' eva pāṇaṃ hanti . . . na musā bhaṇati param pi tathattāya samādapeti yaṃ 'sa hoti dīgharattaṃ hitāya sukhāyā ti. Evam bhante ti. 12. Taṃ kiṃ maññatha Kālāmā --
an3.65:31.4: hitāya vā ahitaya vā ti? Hitāya bhante. Amūḷho panāyaṃ kālāmā purisapuggalo mohena anabhibhūto apariyādinnacitto n' eva pāṇaṃ hanti na adinnam ādiyati na paradāraṃ gacchati na musā bhaṇati param pi tathattāya samādapeti yaṃ 'sa hoti yaṃ dīgharattaṃ hitāya sukhāyā ti?
an3.65:33.1: Taṃ kiṃ maññatha Kālāmā -- ime dhammā kusalā vā akusalā vā ti?
an3.65:39.1: Samattā samādinnā sukhāya saṃvattanti, no vā
an3.65:40.1: Samattā bhante samādinnā hitāya sukhāya saṃvattanti
an3.65:41.1: Iti kho Kālāmā yaṃ taṃ avocumha --
an3.65:41.3: mā anussavena mā paramparāya mā itikirāya mā piṭakasampadānena mā takkahetu mā nayahetu mā ākāraparivitakkena mā diṭṭhinijjhānakkhantiyā mā bhavyarūpatāya mā samaṇo no garū ti,
an3.65:41.4: yadā tumhe Kālāmā attanā va jāneyyātha --
an3.65:41.5: ime dhammā kusalā ime dhammā anavajjā ime dhammā viññuppasatthā ime dhammā samattā samādinnā hitāya sukhāya saṃvattantī ti -- atha tumhe Kālāmā upasampajja vihareyyāthā ti --
an3.65:41.6: iti yan taṃ vuttaṃ idam etaṃ paṭicca vuttaṃ. 15.
an3.65:42.1: Sa kho so Kālāmā ariyasāvako evaṃ vigatābhijjho vigatavyāpādo asammūḷho sampajāno patissato mettāsahagatena cetasā . . .
an3.65:42.4: cetasā . . . ekaṃ disaṃ pharitvā viharati tathā dutiyaṃ tathā tatiyaṃ tathā catuṭṭhiṃ. Iti uddham adho tiriyaṃ sabbadhi sabbattatāya sabbāvantaṃ lokaṃ upekhāsahagatena cetasā vipulena mahaggatena appamāṇena averena avyāpajjhena pharitvā viharati.
an3.65:43.1: Sa kho so Kālāmā ariyasāvako evaṃ averacitto evaṃ avyāpajjhacitto evaṃ asaṅkiliṭṭhacitto evaṃ visuddhacitto,
an3.65:43.2: tassa diṭṭh' eva dhamme cattāro assāsā adhigatā honti. 16.
an3.65:43.3: Sace kho pana atthi paraloko atthi sukaṭadukkaṭānaṃ kammānaṃ phalaṃ vipāko ṭhānam ahaṃ kāyassa bhedā param maraṇā sugatiṃ saggaṃ lokaṃ uppajjissāmī ti. Ayam assa paṭhamo assāso adhigato hoti.
an3.65:44.1: Sace kho pana n' atthi paraloko n' atthi sukaṭadukkaṭānaṃ kammānaṃ phalaṃ vipāko idhāhaṃ diṭṭh' eva dhamme averaṃ avyāpajjhaṃ anīghaṃ sukhiṃ attānaṃ pariharāmī ti. Ayam assa dutiyo assāso adhigato hoti.
an3.65:45.1: Sace kho pana karoto karīyati pāpaṃ na kho panāhaṃ kassaci pāpaṃ cetemi
an3.65:45.2: akarontaṃ kho pana maṃ pāpaṃ kammaṃ kuto dukkhaṃ phusissatī ti. Ayam assa tatiyo assāso adhigato hoti.
an3.65:46.1: Sace kho pana karoto na karīyati pāpaṃ idhāhaṃ ubhayen' eva visuddhaṃ attānaṃ samanupassāmī ti. Ayam assa catuttho assāso adhigato hoti.
an3.65:47.1: Sa kho so ariyasāvako Kālāmā evaṃ averacitto evaṃ avyāpajjhacitto evaṃ asaṅkiliṭṭhacitto evaṃ visuddhacitto
an3.65:47.2: tassa diṭṭh' eva dhamme ime cattāro assāsā adhigatā hontī ti. 17.
an3.65:48.1: Evam etaṃ Bhagavā evam etaṃ Sugata.
an3.65:48.2: Sa kho so bhante ariyasāvako evaṃ averacitto evaṃ avyāpajjhacitto evaṃ asaṅkiliṭṭhacitto evaṃ visuddhacitto
an3.65:48.3: tassa diṭṭh' eva dhamme cattāro assāsā adhigatā honti.
an3.65:48.4: Sace kho pana atthi paraloko atthi sukaṭadukkaṭānaṃ kammānaṃ phalaṃ vipāko ṭhānam ahaṃ kāyassa bhedā param maraṇā sugatiṃ saggaṃ lokaṃ uppajjissāmī ti. Ayam assa paṭhamo assāso adhigato hoti.

an3.65:52.2: tassa diṭṭh' eva dhamme ime cattāro assāsā adhigatā hontī ti.
an3.65:53.2: Ete mayaṃ bhante Bhagavantaṃ saraṇaṃ gacchāma dhammañ ca bhikkhusaṅghañ ca.
an3.65:53.3: Upāsake no bhante Bhagavā dhāretu ajjatagge pāṇupete saraṇaṃ gate
